tools.name: search_filings
tools.description: Search every EDGAR filing with a Lucene-style query, e.g. ticker:AAPL AND formType:"10-K" AND filedAt:[2026-01-01 TO 2026-12-31].

tools.name: full_text_search
tools.description: Search the full text of every filing and exhibit since 2001. Use quotes for exact phrases.

tools.name: extract_section
tools.description: Return one item of a 10-K (1, 1A, 7, 7A...), 10-Q (part1item2, part2item1a...) or 8-K (2-2, 5-2...) as clean text.

tools.name: xbrl_to_json
tools.description: All financial statements and cover page of one filing as JSON, from its XBRL.

tools.name: financial_statements
tools.description: Latest income statement, balance sheet and cash flow (totals only) for a company.

tools.name: company_facts
tools.description: Every XBRL fact a company has ever reported (large).

tools.name: insider_trades
tools.description: Form 3/4/5 insider transactions and holdings with owners, prices, footnotes.

tools.name: form_13f_holdings
tools.description: 13F holdings rows by CUSIP or filer CIK.

tools.name: events_8k
tools.description: 8-K filings by item (1.01, 1.05, 2.02, 4.01, 4.02, 5.02, 5.07...). text=true adds the item text.

tools.name: structured_form
tools.description: Parsed XML forms with every data point. family: form-144, form-13f, form-13d-13g, form-d, form-c, reg-a, n-port, n-cen, n-px.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: EDGAR entity profile: name, SIC, addresses, fiscal year end, former names.

tools.name: map_ticker
tools.description: Ticker to CIK, name and exchange.

tools.name: map_cusip
tools.description: CUSIP to issuer name and ticker.

tools.name: shares_outstanding
tools.description: Shares outstanding and public float history.

tools.name: auditor
tools.description: Auditor name, location and PCAOB ID from the latest annual report.

tools.name: enforcement
tools.description: SEC enforcement releases. kind: litigation-releases, administrative-proceedings, aaer, press-releases.

tools.name: sro_filings
tools.description: SRO rule filings (FINRA, MSRB, DTC, exchanges). Omit org to list organizations.

tools.name: pay_vs_performance
tools.description: Pay versus performance table by year from the proxy's XBRL.

tools.name: equity_dilution
tools.description: Share counts, dilution, stock comp and buybacks over time.

tools.name: executive_compensation
tools.description: Summary Compensation Table by executive and year.

tools.name: directors
tools.description: Board members with compensation, age, tenure.

tools.name: subsidiaries
tools.description: Subsidiaries from Exhibit 21.

tools.name: ipo_filings
tools.description: Registrations and 424B4 offering terms.

tools.name: mergers_acquisitions
tools.description: M&A filings: merger proxies, tender offers, 425, S-4.

tools.name: investment_adviser
tools.description: Form ADV adviser firms: search by name or get one by CRD.

tools.name: list_filing_files
tools.description: Every file in a filing (documents, exhibits, XBRL).

tools.name: governance_dataset
tools.description: Structured data extracted from proxy statements, auditor's reports and SEC enforcement releases. dataset: director-compensation, executive-compensation-governance, severance-change-in-control, board-oversight, shareholder-rights, esg-oversight, compliance-signals, vote-standards, shareholder-proposa

tools.name: audit_report_text
tools.description: Full text of one auditor's report, by the id from the audit-reports datasets.
